scope: Verification that 10-cube gl_3 moment systems have commutator rank <= 2.
theoretical_bound_k_minus_n: rank([H(X),H(Y)]) <= 2*(k-9) for k vectors in gl_3 (dim 9)
interpretation: On gl_3, the Jennrich commutator rank is exactly 2*(k-9) generically. For k=9: rank 0. For k=10: rank <= 2. For k=11 (BILR): rank = 4 (saturated). Therefore any (10,4) pure-cyclic decomposition with traceless free orbits would give at most 10 cubes on gl_3, with commutator rank <= 2. The question is whether the RESIDUAL CUBIC from ANY rank-4 exterior configuration requires Waring rank > 10 on gl_3.
